scope: Only exact pre-existing calculation/role pairs listed here may retain a missing delta-Sternheimer program output. New records are never added automatically. Archiving the real program output retires the issue, the stale entry then blocks integrity, and the entry must be deleted in the same change.
notes: Created on 2026-10-26 when the delta-Sternheimer program-output gate was introduced: the five solid records (C, Si, SiC, MgO, LiH-solid) had archived only summary tables and scheduler excerpts. All ten exception pairs were retired the same day after the owner provided cluster access: the accepted production chains' ABACUS program stdouts and LibRPA program outputs were recovered from the cluster, verified against the archived energies, sanitized, and archived under each record's logs (scientific_role abacus_program_stdout / librpa_program_stdout). The Mg and O reused-atom stdouts were inspected and excluded (cancelled step / no completion marker); the Si record's 2026-08-12 atom-endpoint campaign is no longer on the visible cluster tree and remains table-backed. The file is kept with an empty records list so the mechanism and its audit trail stay visible.
